correctness.rationale: The 8 stated vertices have common norm and exactly 16 edges of equal length. Each generic central section polygon has one edge per transversally cut polyhedron edge. Rescaling the z coordinate preserves oriented signs. All 56 ordered triple-determinant signs are nonzero in Q(sqrt2), so 8 great circles are in general position, yielding at most 8*7+2=58 normal chambers. Independently enumerated locally realized signs at all 28 great-circle pairs and both antipodes, obtained exactly 58 distinct chambers with edge-cut histogram {6:24,8:34}; exhaustion follows from the independent arrangement count. Each edge is cut with Haar probability alpha/pi; all edges share cos alpha=(2sqrt2-1)/7, hence E[N]=16alpha/pi, fixing both probabilities. Finite exact symbolic enumeration is exhaustive here; 250000-point simulation from repository is not its proof.
